out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: hot water temperature was 72f at the hand sink at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the hot water heater.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: high-temperature dishwasher is not sanitizing. Surface temperature of plate simulating dishwasher tester was 131f.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: 3-compartment sink will be used to sanitize all food contact surfaces.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: - OBSERVED: Salmon was thawing in intact ROP packages in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM made a cut in each of the ROP packages.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: utensils were stored in a dipper well with the water not turning on.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM turned on the water.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: - OBSERVED: water heater has stopped working.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: a work order has been placed.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of 2-door 3-drawer prep cooler at 46f, and 1-door 5-drawer cooler at 45f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: a work order has been placed.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: (1) a chemical mixing dispenser was connected downstream from a mop sink with an atmospheric vacuum breaker; (2) a spray nozzle was connected downstream from a mop sink with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM installed an approved splitter on the mop sink.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @EQUIPMENT@ is not observed. - OBSERVED: there is no air gap between each drain line of 3-compartment sink and grease trap.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please create an air gap between each drain line of the 3-compartment sink and the grease trap.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: CFM IS NOT ABLE TO PRESENT A PARASITE DESTRUCTION STATEMENT FOR SALMON
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PLEASE OBTAIN A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM YOUR VENDOR.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: (1) SHREDDED MOZZARELLA CHEESE (43-44F) WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER FOR 4 HOURS; (2) PICKLED ONION (45F) WAS STORED IN DELFIELD 3-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER FOR 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: (1) BUTTER MILK (44F) WAS STORED IN 2-DOOR 3-DRAWER PREP COOLER (PASTA) OVERNIGHT; (2) CHICKEN DUMPLING (44F) WAS STORED IN 1-DOOR 5-DRAWER PREP COOLER (PANTRY) OVERNIGHT; (3) SLICED CHICKEN (46F) WAS STORED IN TRAULSEN 2-DOOR DISPLAY COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS. CALIFORNIA PIZZA KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 11/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER IS CONNECTED DOWNSTREAM FROM A MOP SINK WITH ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. A MIXING SPOON WAS STORED IN BAR HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM SENT THE MIXING SPOON TO WASH.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: 1. CHECCA (DICED TOMATO, 50F) FAILED TO COOL DOWN FROM AMBIENT TEMPERATURE TO 41F IN 4 HOURS; 2. BBQ CHICKEN (45F), DICED TOMATO (45F), AND CUT LETTUCE (51F) WERE STORED IN 1-DOOR 5-DRAWER COOLER (PANTRY) FOR ABOUT 4 HOURS AND FAILED TO BE COOLED DOWN TO 41F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: DUMPLINGS (55F) WERE STORED IN A PLASTIC CONTAINER AND DIVIDED BY PLASTIC MEMBRANE FOR 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. DUMPLINGS WERE TRANSFERRED TO A SHEET PAN AND STORED IN WALKING COOLER.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: ROP PACKAGES OF FROZEN SALMON WERE THAWING IN INTACT ROP PACKAGES IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: CFM MADE A CUT IN EACH ROP PACKAGE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED CUCUMBER JUICE AND STRAWBERRY JUICE IN SQUEEZE BOTTLES WITHOUT LABELS
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELED THE FOOD ITEMS.
